_comment: Tier-2 for febio::polar_fluid#2. Scaling <tau>, <beta> and <gamma> across four decades on the shipped channel deck leaves the logged element data BIT-IDENTICAL. The fixture first proves the deck IS bit-reproducible by running it twice unchanged — without that, an exact-invariance assertion would be meaningless — and only then asserts equality across the sweep. That exact invariance is the tell the claim asks for before any polar-vs-classical comparison. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'polar_invariance=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden tokens 'FAIL:', 'not_reproduced' appear. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
